newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady in thin activity.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates steady in thin activity.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mostly steady on the Mid-Mississippi on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said.
No barges traded, the same as Monday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, this week, 115 percent of tariff, unchanged from Friday, similar, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi, next week, bid 115 percent, no offer.
- 18 barges, Mid-Mississippi, two each week May/June, bid 115 percent, offer 125 percent.
